title: Chapter 24: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

blocks.content: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) is the apex regulatory body responsible for supervising and regulating the insurance sector in India. Its main objective is to protect the interests of policyholders while ensuring the orderly growth of the insurance industry.

items: IRDAI is identified as the apex regulatory body specifically for India's insurance sector.
Questions frequently focus on IRDAI's main objective: balancing policyholder protection with orderly industry growth.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: IRDAI is the apex regulatory authority governing the insurance sector in India.
The primary mandate of the authority is protecting the interests of policyholders.
It is responsible for driving and maintaining orderly growth within the insurance industry.
